findings.rationale: An admin role is broadly assumable, granting excessive privileges.
A policy grants sts:AssumeRole action with an overly broad scope, allowing assumption of various roles.
An IAM role trusts an external principal, potentially allowing unauthorized access from outside the AWS account.

findings.control: identity boundary: MFA condition on sensitive trust
findings.rationale: An external trust relationship lacks a mandatory MFA condition, increasing the risk of unauthorized access.
